 Oral Order
2 06-01-2026

Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned APP for the State.
2. The instant application for anticipatory bail has been filed by the petitioner apprehending his arrest in connection with Complaint Case no. 320 of 2024 instituted for the offence under Sections 406, 420 & 120B of the IPC.

3. As per prosecution, petitioner along with co- accused Babloo Bhuwaniya has executed an agreement with the complainant for the sale of a piece of land worth Rs. 9,50,000/- and an amount of 6,17,000/- was taken in advance by the petitioner and the other co-accused persons.

Thereafter,
the accused persons under conspiracy refused to execute the sale deed as mentioned in the agreement.

When the informant asked to return the amount, co-accused Babloo Bhuwaniya gave a Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.88062 of 2025(2) dt.06-01-2026 cheque of Rs. 5,80,000/-, which got dishonored due to insufficient balance in the bank account of co-accused.
4. Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner has submitted that petitioner is innocent and has committed no offence.
Petitioner was only a witness in the agreement dated 02.09.2021 for execution of sale deed.
Petitioner is neither borrower nor purchaser of the aforesaid land.

It is only alleged against the petitioner is that he took Rs. 57,000/- as cash from the complainant but in the agreement of the land the same was not mentioned which suggest that a concocted story was implanted against the petitioner to implicate him in the present case.
Petitioner has got no criminal antecedent.

6. Having heard learned counsel for the parties and in the facts and circumstances of the case as stated above, this Court is inclined to enlarge the petitioner on bail.

The petitioner is directed to surrender in the Court below within a period of four weeks from today and in the event of his arrest or surrender in connection with Complaint Case no. 320 of 2024, he will be enlarged on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 10,000/- (Rupees Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.88062 of 2025(2)
dt.06-01-2026 ten thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned CJM, Banka,
subject to the conditions as laid down under section 482(2) of the BNS.

(S. B. Pd. Singh, J) khushbu/-
